Bartrd 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Trade skills with university students using a credit-based system, no cash required.
- Search for skill trades, post new offers or requests, and accept matches after user confirmation.
- Easily check your Bartrd credit balance and pending credits.
- Estimate and spend credits on AI-powered services (copy, notes, code, brief), always showing cost up front.
